title: Where windows overlap
hints: Treat each axis on its own: two ranges `[a, a+w)` and `[b, b+w)` overlap from `max(start)` to `min(end)`.
Compute `left = max(a.x, b.x)`, `right = min(a.x + a.w, b.x + b.w)`, and the same for top/bottom. If `right <= left` or `bottom <= top`, there's no overlap: return `false` before touching `out`.
`if (out != NULL) { *out = (Rect){ left, top, right - left, bottom - top }; } return true;` and `rect_area` is just `r->w * r->h`.
